_comment: Hierarchical MILP AllGather on dual_plane_hetero_leaf_down with switch copy. dual_plane_hetero with plane 1's leaf2 removed: hosts 4-7 become single-homed on plane 0 (half their off-host bandwidth). Hierarchical only. milp_chunking='cell': one MILP chunk = one host's chunks for one destination-cell set. Smallest model; voids multipath on hosts with more than one uplink -- the tractability fallback. switch_copy [true, false]: the network switches of the coarse level copy -- a fan-out is one Send, charged once on its uplink, and ncclize emits it as ONE multicast send threadblock (tb send="r1,r2") with one mscclflowid, plus a switch-JSON (format 2) entry listing every out port; the cell NVSwitches do not copy (multicast there needs NVLS). Pass --no-multicast to ncclize for the pre-multicast output (one unicast send per branch). SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs). objective_type 6 (LEXICOGRAPHIC) puts makespan first; PAPER (3) ties on it. Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md and teccl/ncclize/multicast_output_design.md.
